name: Fall Flavors
source:
You are the older brother who is staying with your sibling. You are trying to find a direction in life.
The game is built on choices that will have an impact on the gameplay.  Scenes will unfold based on your decisions.
This is a semi kinetic story with some options along the way.
translation:
你是和你兄弟姐妹住在一起的哥哥。你正在努力寻找人生的方向。
游戏建立在对游戏玩法产生影响的选择之上。场景将根据你的决定展开。
这是一个半动态的故事，一路上有一些选择。
